provisionalMutationScore.unit: distinct application file and mutation ID after test repair
provisionalMutationScore.limitations: Selected faults only; not an exhaustive or random mutation score. Before-test experiments and inverse defect repair probes are excluded. Repeated copies of experiment evidence are deduplicated.

defects.title: Exported fnv1a does not compute the documented 32-bit FNV-1a hash
defects.evidence: Independently reproduced in the root audit worktree. BigInt XOR/multiply/modulo-2^32 arithmetic gives 4f9f2cab; the exported function returns a82fb4a1. Its floating-point multiplication loses low bits.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; ordinary failure and inverse repair probe recorded. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: VS Code reinforcement omits the required signal and supplies a file path as a memory ID
defects.expected: The selected memory receives useful reinforcement and its persisted modified date becomes today.
defects.actual: The real CLI rejects the command because --signal is required; the memory remains dated 2000-01-01.
defects.evidence: The public extension command was invoked through a VS Code host boundary double and executed the local CLI. A temporary probe supplying --signal useful and the fixture memory ID makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: VS Code memory-directory validation accepts names such as .gnosys-other
defects.expected: The outside-memory-directory warning appears and reinforcement is not invoked.
defects.actual: Substring validation accepts .gnosys-other and invokes the reinforcement subprocess.
defects.evidence: The selected path ends in .gnosys-other/memory.md. Requiring an exact path component makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: VS Code reinforcement evaluates shell syntax in selected filenames
defects.expected: The literal argument decisions/$(touch audit-injected).md reaches the CLI without evaluating the shell expression.
defects.actual: The argument becomes decisions/.md and a harmless audit-injected marker is created in the isolated fixture directory.
defects.evidence: The real shell ran only a harmless touch command inside the temporary test project. Replacing shell interpolation with execFileSync argument passing makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: VS Code dashboard action invokes a removed CLI command
defects.expected: The terminal runs a supported CLI command and exits successfully.
defects.actual: npx gnosys dashboard exits 1 because dashboard is not a registered command.
defects.evidence: The terminal host double executes the real built CLI through a local npx shim. A temporary supported status --system command makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails; passing restoration and inverse repair probes recorded. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: Task routing reset reports success but retains persisted overrides
defects.actual: The structuring override remains xai/grok-4.20 despite routing reset success.
defects.evidence: The real summary wizard receives 2,4,y,done and its project config is reloaded. updateConfig recursively merges the empty taskModels object, retaining previous keys. A temporary clear-overrides repair makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: Main setup cancellation returns success instead of interrupt status
defects.testName: gnosys setup exits cleanly on SIGINT
defects.expected: Exit code130 after Ctrl+C at the real provider prompt.
defects.actual: The cancellation message appears but the process exits0.
defects.evidence: A Python POSIX PTY waits for the real prompt and sends the Ctrl+C byte. The main setup close listener exits0 before safeQuestion can exit130. Models and IDE setup return130 through the same PTY.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails. Application code unchanged.

defects.title: Writing the same memory twice duplicates full-text search results
defects.testName: writing the same memory twice keeps one searchable result
defects.expected: One stored memory and one search result after repeated syncMemoryToDb writes.
defects.actual: One stored memory but two search results with the same ID.
defects.evidence: Two public syncMemoryToDb writes followed by getAllMemories and searchFts reproduce the mismatch. A temporary FTS-row replacement repair makes the expected-failure test unexpectedly pass.
defects.status: Confirmed. Retained as it.fails. Application code unchanged.
